\documentclass{amsart}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{mathtools,xcolor,hyperref}
\setlength{\textwidth}{440pt}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\theoremstyle{definition}
\newtheorem{definition}[theorem]{Definition}
\newenvironment{claim}[1][Auxiliary]{\begin{lemma}[#1]}{\end{lemma}}
\newcommand{\base}{X}
\newcommand{\weight}[2][2]{#1\base_{#2}}
\DeclareMathOperator{\rank}{rank}
\DeclarePairedDelimiter{\norm}{\lVert}{\rVert}
\NewDocumentCommand{\pair}{O{a} m}{\langle #1,#2\rangle}
\begin{document}
\section{Synthetic arguments}
\begin{definition}[Working norm]
DEFINITIONCONTROL uses $\norm{\base}=\weight{a}$ and $\pair{b}$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Uniform bound]\label{thm:bound}
THEOREMMACRO has $\weight[3]{b}+\rank A=\norm*{\base}$.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
PROOFMACRO uses $\pair[c]{d}$ and $\weight{a}$.

\begin{enumerate}
\item FIRSTCASE has $\norm{\base}$.
\item SECONDCASE has $\weight[4]{b}$.
\end{enumerate}
\begin{align*}
\norm{\base} &\leq \weight{a},\\
\rank A &\leq 3.\qedhere
\end{align*}
\end{proof}

\begin{claim}[Nested notation]
CLAIMCONTROL has $\weight[5]{c}$.
\begin{proof}[Subargument]
INNERPROOF uses $\pair[x]{y}$.
\end{proof}
\end{claim}

{\renewcommand{\base}{K}\color{blue}
LOCALCONTROL has $\weight{a}$ and $\norm{\base}$.\par}

GLOBALCONTROL uses $\weight{a}$ after Theorem~\ref{thm:bound}.
\end{document}
